note: JSON:API Search API has NO config of its own (configure=null), no settings form, no permissions, no Drush, no plugin types. It exposes every ENABLED Search API index as a JSON:API resource at /%jsonapi%/index/<id> via a dynamic route generator (Routing\Routes::routes()), served by Resource\IndexResource. Query params map to Search API: filter[fulltext] -> keywords, filter[...] -> conditions (operators =,<>,>,>=,<,<=,IN,NOT IN,BETWEEN,NOT BETWEEN,IS NULL,IS NOT NULL; NOT STARTS_WITH/CONTAINS/ENDS_WITH), sort -> sorts, page[offset]/page[limit] -> range. meta is extensible via event jsonapi_search_api.add_search_meta. Medium/hard are grounded in the module's real behaviour (route-per-enabled-index) without a live external server: cases build a DB-backed (search_api_db) server + index. verify calls the module's own Routes::routes() generator (no router rebuild needed) and checks jsonapi_search_api.index_<id> - which only exists when the index is enabled.

evals.prompt: With the jsonapi_search_api module, at what URL is a Search API index exposed over JSON:API, and which indexes get a route?
evals.expected_output: Each enabled Search API index is exposed at /%jsonapi%/index/<index_id> (default /jsonapi/index/<id>), via a route jsonapi_search_api.index_<id> generated by Routing\Routes::routes(). Only enabled indexes get a route.

evals.prompt: How do I run a fulltext search and paginate when querying a jsonapi_search_api index endpoint? Which query parameters are used?
evals.expected_output: Use filter[fulltext]=<terms> to set the search keywords, page[offset] and page[limit] for pagination, sort for sorting, and filter[...] for conditions. E.g. GET /jsonapi/index/content?filter[fulltext]=climate&page[limit]=10&sort=-created.

evals.prompt: How can another module add extra data (for example facets) to the meta section of a jsonapi_search_api search response?
evals.expected_output: Subscribe to the event jsonapi_search_api.add_search_meta (Events::ADD_SEARCH_META) and use AddSearchMetaEvent::setMeta($key, $value). The IndexResource dispatches it before responding; this is how the facets submodule adds meta.facets.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an enabled Search API index named jsa_known. Given the jsonapi_search_api module, at what JSON:API URL path is that index's search resource exposed?
evals.expected_output: It is exposed at /jsonapi/index/jsa_known (route jsonapi_search_api.index_jsa_known), because jsonapi_search_api creates a route for every enabled index.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Search API index jsa_task (attached to server jsa_task_srv) that is currently disabled, so jsonapi_search_api does not expose it. Make jsonapi_search_api expose index jsa_task as a JSON:API resource, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the index (set status TRUE and save; it already has server jsa_task_srv). jsonapi_search_api only routes enabled indexes, so once enabled Routing\Routes::routes() produces route jsonapi_search_api.index_jsa_task at /jsonapi/index/jsa_task.
